notes: Finer reading: the problem side splits into stakes, volume overload, and training-cost premises because each could fail independently; workflow/channel (D3) and data partnerships (D4) are kept as singleton domains — the data-for-technology exchange is a distinct learnable mechanism feeding the algorithms, and channel structure stands apart from it.
